description: This file declares functions for creating various ASN.1 objects related to X.520 names, distinguished names, and associated concepts. It defines the interface for a library that handles ASN.1 encoding/decoding of name-related structures used in cryptography and directory services.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateName
methods.description: Creates a new ASN.1 Name object representing the hierarchical distinguished name structure.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateRDNSequence
methods.description: Creates a new ASN.1 RDNSequence object, which is a sequence of relative distinguished names.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new ASN.1 Attribute object, consisting of an attribute type and set of values.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateRelativeDistinguishedName
methods.description: Creates a new RelativeDistinguishedName object, which is a set of attributes.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateAttributeTypeAndValue
methods.description: Creates a new AttributeTypeAndValue object, pairing an attribute type OID with its value.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateAttributeValues
methods.description: Creates an AttributeValues object that contains a set of attribute values.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateAttributeValue
methods.description: Creates a new ASN.1 AttributeValue object, which can be one of several ASN.1 types.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateX520name
methods.description: Creates an X520name object, representing various string formats for distinguished names.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateUnstructuredName
methods.description: Creates an UnstructuredName object, supporting multiple string formats.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateDirectoryString
methods.description: Creates a DirectoryString object, a flexible string type in ASN.1.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateMessageDigest
methods.description: Creates a MessageDigest object, typically an octet string representing a hash.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateSigningTime
methods.description: Creates a SigningTime object, representing a timestamp.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateChllengePassword
methods.description: Creates a ChallengePassword object, supporting multiple string formats.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateUnstructuredAddress
methods.description: Creates an UnstructuredAddress object with multiple string format options.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateContentType
methods.description: Creates a ContentType object, an OID indicating content type.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateX520CommonName
methods.description: Creates an X520CommonName object with various string options.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateX520LocalityName
methods.description: Creates an X520LocalityName object, supporting multiple string formats.
